A man jumps from a stationary balloon. After falling several hundred metres, he opens his
parachute.
At which position is his kinetic energy greatest?
A
just after he jumps from the balloon
B
just before he opens his parachute
C
just after his parachute opens
D
just before he lands

options.label: A
options.text: just after he jumps from the balloon

options.label: B
options.text: just before he opens his parachute
